reason: I top up at the dekkene most days, bread and labneh when I need them, sometimes on my tab. Twice a week at their hour is not how I shop, and I'd still have to go and collect it.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. I buy a little every day, not two big runs a week, and the village dekkene already gives me the tab.
would_change_my_mind: Free delivery to my door on the same day, with no tab-style charge, and daily or on-demand ordering instead of only Tuesday and Friday.
